basic_details.offering_entity: Hungarian Government (Tempus Public Foundation / Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Trade) & Government of Pakistan (HEC)
basic_details.host_institutions_covered: Hungarian State Universities (Eötvös Loránd University - ELTE, Budapest University of Technology - BME, University of Debrecen, University of Szeged, Corvinus, University of Pécs, MATE)
basic_details.major_restrictions: Eligible for almost all fields of study: Engineering, Computer Science, Natural Sciences, Medicine, Dentistry, Pharmacy, Agriculture, Business, Social Sciences, Arts and Humanities.
basic_details.number_of_awards_total: ~5,000 scholarship holders admitted annually worldwide from 90+ sending partners
basic_details.number_of_awards_pakistan: 400 reserved bilateral quota seats for Pakistani students annually (200 Bachelor's, 100 Master's, 70 One-Tier Master's/Medicine, 30 PhD)
basic_details.duration_of_scholarship: Bachelor's: 3-4 years; Master's: 1.5-2 years; One-Tier Master's (Medicine): 5-6 years; PhD: 4 years

nationality_requirements: Citizens of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan
eligibility_requirements.age_limit_notes: Must be at least 18 years old by 31 August of entry year. HEC Pakistan enforces age limits: max 22-24 for Bachelor's; max 35 for Master's/PhD (up to 40 for regular public sector/faculty).
eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: 12 years education (HSSC/A-Levels) for Bachelor's; 16 years education (BS/MA/MSc) for Master's; 18 years education (MS/MPhil) for PhD.
eligibility_requirements.grading_conversion_notes: Minimum 60% marks in annual system or 2.50/4.00 CGPA in semester system.
eligibility_requirements.subject_background_prerequisites: Relevant pre-requisite courses matching the chosen Hungarian degree.
eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Completed degrees; result-awaiting candidates can apply if final result is declared before HEC nomination deadline.
eligibility_requirements.language_notes: Varies by Hungarian university: IELTS 5.5 to 6.5, TOEFL iBT 72 to 90, or Duolingo 95+. Many Hungarian universities accept English Medium of Instruction (MOI) certificates from Pakistani universities or conduct their own online oral English interview.
eligibility_requirements.other_language_requirements: None required; 1 year Hungarian language preparatory option available.
eligibility_requirements.special_eligibility_categories: Candidates must be formally nominated by the Higher Education Commission (HEC) Pakistan.
eligibility_requirements.previous_scholarship_restrictions: Previous Stipendium Hungaricum scholarship holders who re-apply within the same study level are restricted.

tuition_fee.details: 100% exemption from the payment of tuition fees for the entire duration of the degree program.

admission_application_fee.details: No university application fee when applying through the Stipendium Hungaricum system.

accommodation.details: Free university dormitory placement OR a monthly housing allowance of HUF 40,000/month towards private accommodation.

monthly_stipend.details: Monthly living stipend paid directly by the Hungarian host university for 12 months a year.
monthly_stipend.amount: HUF 43,700/mo for Undergrad/Master; HUF 140,000/mo (Phase 1) and HUF 180,000/mo (Phase 2) for PhD (~PKR 35,000 to 145,000/mo)

airfare.details: International airfare between Pakistan and Hungary is NOT covered by the Hungarian government (must be paid by student or HEC).

visa_fee.details: Type D Hungarian Student Visa application fee is WAIVED for Stipendium Hungaricum scholarship holders at the Hungarian Embassy in Islamabad.

health_insurance.details: Hungarian National Health Insurance (TAJ Card) providing full medical services under Hungarian law, plus supplementary private health insurance up to HUF 65,000/year.

food_allowance.details: Subsidized meals available at university canteens.

books_and_materials_allowance.details: Covered via stipend or campus library access.

research_funding_conference_grant.details: University departmental doctoral grants available for PhD candidates.

travel_transit_allowance.details: Local transport in Budapest/Debrecen purchased at heavily discounted student rate (~HUF 3,450/month).

university_and_program_options.single_or_multiple_universities: Applicants may select up to TWO study programs (at either 2 different universities or the same university) in order of preference (Priority 1 and Priority 2).
participating_institutions: ELTE Budapest, BME, University of Debrecen, University of Szeged, Corvinus Budapest, University of Pécs, MATE, Óbuda University, Széchenyi István University
university_and_program_options.university_rankings_scope: Top 1 to 10 universities in Hungary; QS World Rankings 500-1000.
university_and_program_options.program_duration: Bachelor's: 3-4 years; Master's: 1.5-2 years; One-tier Master's: 5-6 years; PhD: 4 years
university_and_program_options.admission_requirements_summary: Online application, transcripts, medical certificate, motivation letter, institutional online exam / Skype interview.
university_and_program_options.easiest_hardest_institutions_guidance: Single application through DreamApply portal; institutional entrance exams are held online in April/May.
university_and_program_options.strategic_program_match_advice: Priority 1 choice receives maximum focus from universities; ensure Priority 1 is your strongest academic alignment.

application_process_roadmap.portal_system_name: DreamApply Online Application System & HEC Scholarship Portal (scholarship.hec.gov.pk)
application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: MANDATORY DUAL SUBMISSION: 1) Register and apply on the Hungarian DreamApply portal; AND 2) Register and apply on the HEC Pakistan Scholarship portal.
step_by_step_workflow: 1. Register on Tempus DreamApply portal (opens mid-November).
2. Select 2 study programs in order of preference.
3. Upload transcripts, certificates, medical certificate, motivation letter, and passport.
4. Submit DreamApply application by January 15 deadline.
5. Register on HEC Pakistan Scholarship portal (scholarship.hec.gov.pk).
6. Fill HEC online profile and submit under 'Stipendium Hungaricum' category.
7. Take HEC USAT (for Undergrad) or HEC HAT (for Master's/PhD) aptitude test.
8. HEC prepares national merit list based on academic formula (50%) + HAT/USAT score (50%).
9. HEC nominates top 400 candidates (+ reserve list) to Tempus Public Foundation in February.
10. Nominated candidates take online entrance examinations/interviews with Hungarian universities (March - May).
11. Tempus Public Foundation issues final Letters of Award in June/July.
12. Apply for Hungarian Type D Visa at Embassy in Islamabad and depart in September.
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: Integrated DreamApply routing + HEC national nomination.
application_process_roadmap.recommendation_letters_submission_method: Required for PhD applicants (2 letters of recommendation from professors with doctoral degrees); not mandatory for Bachelor's/Master's.
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Motivation Letter (minimum 1 page / 4,000 characters): Why Hungary, reasons for selecting specific programs, and career ambitions.
application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: PhD applicants must upload a detailed research plan (minimum 2 pages) and statement of supervisor acceptance.
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: Online institutional entrance exam (written test) followed by 10-15 minute oral interview via Skype/Teams conducted by Hungarian faculty professors.
application_process_roadmap.standardized_tests: HEC USAT (Undergrad) or HEC HAT (Postgrad) required for Pakistani nomination. Hungarian universities conduct their own subject tests.
application_process_roadmap.application_fee_amount: HUF 0 (Tempus application is free; HEC charges nominal test fee PKR 2,000 for HAT/USAT).
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: Degrees must be attested by HEC / IBCC and Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MOFA) prior to visa issuance.
application_process_roadmap.translation_requirements: Certified English translations if originals are in Urdu.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Passport valid for at least 18 months
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Required for DreamApply registration and visa

required_documents_checklist.specification: Matric, Inter, Bachelor's, and Master's degrees and detailed marks certificates
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Must be attested by IBCC (matric/inter) and HEC (degrees)

required_documents_checklist.specification: IELTS, TOEFL, Duolingo, or English Medium of Instruction certificate
Official medical certificate from registered physician confirming negative tests for HIV, Hepatitis B/C, and Chest X-ray
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Mandatory Tempus template issued not older than 1 month

required_documents_checklist.specification: Minimum 1 page detailing academic purpose and Hungarian context
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Address both Priority 1 and Priority 2 programs

important_dates_timeline.interview_period: March - May (Online entrance exams and Skype interviews)
important_dates_timeline.shortlist_announcement: HEC nomination in late February; Final awards in June/July
important_dates_timeline.annual_cycle_notes: Both DreamApply and HEC portal applications must be completed before their respective deadlines.

selection_process_and_weights.academic_weight: 40% (Matric, Inter, and Bachelor's marks calculated via HEC formula)
selection_process_and_weights.research_experience_weight: 15% (For PhD applicants; proposal review by Hungarian supervisors)
selection_process_and_weights.interview_weight: 20% (Hungarian university institutional exam and oral interview score)
selection_process_and_weights.test_scores_weight: HEC USAT / HAT test accounts for 50% of the initial national nomination score in Pakistan!
selection_process_and_weights.selection_panel_composition: Stage 1: HEC Pakistan National Nomination Committee; Stage 2: Hungarian University Departmental Admissions Committees; Stage 3: Tempus Board of Trustees.
selection_process_and_weights.evaluation_methodology: HEC nominates candidate pool via academic + test merit; Hungarian universities examine candidates via online tests/interviews and give admission scores (Pass/Fail/Waitlist); Tempus confirms awards.

competitiveness_profile.total_annual_applicants: ~10,000 to 14,000 applicants in Pakistan across all degree levels
competitiveness_profile.total_scholarships_awarded: 400 principal awards exclusively reserved for Pakistan annually
competitiveness_profile.acceptance_rate_pakistan: ~2.8% to 4.0% (Moderate-High Competition, but largest European quota for Pakistan)
competitiveness_profile.typical_academic_and_research_profile: Solid grades in intermediate/bachelor's and strong score on HEC USAT/HAT test (typically 65+ out of 100).
competitiveness_profile.common_backgrounds_of_winners: FSc Pre-Medical and Pre-Engineering students (for BS and Medicine); graduates of UET, NUST, FAST, COMSATS, Punjab University, Karachi University.
competitiveness_profile.high_representation_countries: Reserved exclusively for Pakistan under bilateral cultural agreement.

fake_websites_and_scams: Agents in Lahore, Rawalpindi, and Karachi charging PKR 100,000 to 300,000 claiming they 'guarantee nomination on the HEC Hungary quota'. HEC nominations are strictly computerized and merit-based.
red_flags_and_warnings.application_fee_warning: DreamApply is completely FREE. HEC charges only the standard test registration fee for HAT/USAT (~PKR 2,000).
red_flags_and_warnings.agent_and_intermediary_warnings: Never hire an agent. All portals and communication are direct with the applicant.
hidden_costs_breakdown: International flight ticket to Budapest: NOT covered by Hungarian scholarship (PKR 180,000 to 250,000 one-way/return).
HEC & IBCC document attestation fees and MOFA apostille stamps (PKR 10,000 to 20,000).
Medical screening lab tests (HIV, Hepatitis, X-Ray: approx PKR 10,000 to 15,000).
Monthly stipend limitation: HUF 43,700 (~PKR 35,000/mo) for undergrad/master is tight; students often need modest personal pocket money support (~€100-€150/mo) or part-time work.
misleading_claims_debunked: MYTH: Flights are covered. (Fact: Airfare is explicitly the responsibility of the student).
MYTH: You cannot work in Hungary. (Fact: International students can legally work up to 30 hours/week during study term in Hungary).
official_vs_unofficial_discrepancies: Agents often fail to inform applicants about the mandatory HEC portal application; applying on DreamApply without applying on the HEC portal results in immediate disqualification for Pakistanis.

scholarship_obligations_and_terms.minimum_gpa_maintenance: Must earn at least 36 credits across every two consecutive semesters (or 18 credits per semester) according to Hungarian institutional regulations.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.attendance_requirements: Physical residence in Hungary mandatory. Being absent for more than 30 consecutive days without written permission leads to scholarship termination.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.academic_progress_monitoring: Semi-annual credit and attendance reports sent by universities to Tempus Public Foundation.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.work_restrictions_during_study: Students holding a Hungarian Residence Permit for Study purposes may work up to 30 hours per week during term-time and full-time during vacations.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.home_country_return_obligation: No mandatory home residency restriction enforced by Hungary; students can transition to Hungarian 9-month Job Seeker Residence Permit upon graduation or pursue PhDs across the EU.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.service_obligations_or_bonds: HEC Pakistan requires signing an undertaking form agreeing to return, though enforcement is non-statutory for self-funded travel.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.repayment_clawback_conditions: If a student drops out without certified medical emergency, scholarship funding and health insurance terminate immediately.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_university: Permitted ONCE during the scholarship tenure within the first year of studies, subject to approval by both Hungarian universities and Tempus.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_major: Permitted ONCE, strictly within the same sending partner quota and study level.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.extension_policy: Bachelor's and Master's programs can be extended by a maximum of 2 semesters upon written application and university approval (stipend is suspended during extension, but tuition remains waived).
